metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: org.jooq:jooq
leads.reason: jOOQ Parser (DSL.using(dialect).parser().parseQuery) returns a Query object model traversable through the QOM $-API; documented in the jOOQ manual.

leads.name: com.alibaba:druid
leads.reason: Druid's SQL module: SQLUtils.parseStatements(sql, DbType) returns SQLStatement ASTs (SQLSelectStatement, SQLInsertStatement). The artifact also contains a JDBC connection pool.

leads.name: com.facebook.presto:presto-parser
leads.reason: Presto SqlParser.createStatement returns an AST Statement (Query, Insert).

leads.name: org.apache.hive:hive-exec
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. ParseDriver.parse(command) returns a ParseResult whose getTree() is the HiveQL ASTNode tree (TOK_QUERY, TOK_FROM, TOK_JOIN, TOK_INSERT_INTO, ...); documented in the Hive 4.2.1 Javadocs. The parser classes ship in the hive-exec uber jar.

leads.name: io.trino:trino-parser
leads.reason: Trino SqlParser.createStatement; same ANTLR lineage as presto-parser.

leads.name: io.prestosql:presto-parser
leads.reason: PrestoSQL (pre-Trino rename) parser; same lineage as trino-parser.

leads.name: org.apache.spark:spark-catalyst_2.13
leads.reason: Spark Catalyst CatalystSqlParser.parsePlan returns a LogicalPlan; Scala artifact with a large runtime.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine
leads.reason: ShardingSphere SQL parser engine (ANTLR per dialect).

leads.name: com.github.vertical-blank:sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter that returns text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: net.sf.jsqlparser:jsqlparser
leads.reason: Ancient JSqlParser coordinate (0.7.0); superseded by com.github.jsqlparser:jsqlparser.
